text:
maria: Quick consolidation from the auth token outage postmortem (INC-2123). Root causes: vendor signing key expired without automated rotate, permission-canary not enabled in eu-west, and audit payloads missing user_id on two token endpoints. Posting actions + owners. Please ack and call dibs. :warning:

lee: i'll take the canary + predeploy tests. plan: add 4 small pytest checks that run in the pre-deploy stage and a datadog log-based metric. target 2026-04-01. created tracker card: https://redwood/tracker/INC-2123-canary

ton y: grabbing key-rotation automation and the KMS role changes. will add a GH workflow and a dry-run that prints the swap plan. ETA: 2026-03-29 for dry-run logs. need sec approval for iam:Decrypt on rotation-sa.

ops: on-prem maintenance window requested: 2026-04-14 02:00-05:00 UTC. managed customers will get notice on 2026-04-07. air-gapped installs require manual scheduling.

sec-bot: Reminder: owners must acknowledge actions within 24h or it escalates. Tracker: https://redwood/tracker/INC-2123. Auto-remind in 48h.

lee: proposed datadog query (please tweak):

```
logs("service:auth AND http.path:/api/token/* AND !user_id").rollup("count").last("10m") > 5
```

infra: route that alert to #eng-oncall and escalate to pager after 2 fires. also add a pre-deploy gate to fail the rollout if the canary fails.

ton y: rotation plan = monthly scheduled rotate with staged swap; keeping previous key valid for 40h (decided to go 40h this cycle). rotation script supports `--staged` and `--rollback`. example: `scripts/rotate-keys --staged --verify`. will document commands in the runbook.

maria: audit logging owner? we need user_id + request_id emitted for /api/token/issue and /api/token/refresh. without user_id we can't link authz denies.

lee: i can help with a short migration test for consumers. but someone should own the actual event emission.

ton y: maria, can you own audit events? looks like you're coordinating the postmortem.

maria: i will own audit events. est 2 sprints, can compress to 1 sprint if we freeze low-priority prs. i'll open draft PR: redwood/auth#1307 and add a compatibility flag so consumers can opt-in early.

infra: checklist added to tracker card (copied): - [ ] GH workflow + CI dry-run (tony) - [ ] IAM policy diff + sec approval (tony + security) - [ ] Emit user_id + request_id (maria) - [ ] Permission canary + predeploy tests (lee) - [ ] Playbook + runbook updates (infra) - [ ] Customer notice for on-prem (ops)

ton y: note on rollback: if a rotation fails, run `scripts/rotate-keys --rollback` within the staged window. will add a step-by-step rollback snippet in the runbook.

maria: i'll add migration notes: emit both old and new event keys for 14 days; add a backfill job for last 7 days of events that lacked user_id.

ops: we'll publish the customer notice on 2026-04-07 and staff the window. ops will also confirm which managed customers need manual opt-in.

lee: acked. starting tracker card and will push initial test PR by EOD.

ton y: acked. pinging @security for the iam diff.

sec-bot: Security request: please attach the IAM policy diff and a justification on the tracker card for review.

infra: added runbook link to the postmortem draft: https://redwood/docs/runbooks/auth-key-rotation. also created a short playbook entry for canary firing (block rollout -> page oncall -> run rollback if rotation failed).

maria: assigning owners formally: tony -> rotation + IAM; lee -> canary/tests; maria -> audit events + backfill; infra -> runbook/playbook; ops -> customer notices. next quick sync Wed 09:15 to surface blockers. leaving thread open for short updates. :spiral_calendar_pad: :thumbsup:
